description: This file declares functions and types related to handling PKCS#12 blobs, including importing and exporting certificates and private keys, within the mozilla_security_manager namespace.

methods.name: nsPKCS12Blob_Import
methods.description: Imports a PKCS#12 blob into a specified slot, optionally marking the private key as non-extractable, and returns imported certificates.

methods.name: nsPKCS12Blob_Export
methods.description: Exports given certificates into a PKCS#12 blob, returning the number of certificates exported.
